answer: Trust-graph diffusion curbs Sybil attacks by bounding random walks across agent networks. Identities derive reputation from an anchor grove of seed nodes, propagating flow scores over a peer whisper protocol to detect topological bottlenecks. An adversary incurs the verifiable relational cost of securing scarce, genuine endorsements from honest agents to extract transaction nectar. However, peripheral honest agents with sparse connectivity suffer from false-positive rejections.
